findings.severity: open finding, acceptance-blocking for item 1's bit-equality bar
findings.description: Cross-session KV adoption is not bit-exact under greedy decode: cold full prefill (968 tokens) vs adopted-partial prefill (68 remaining tokens after a 900-token snapshot) diverge at generation position ~7 of 24 (one compound-token spelling flip); divergence position and flip are IDENTICAL across all three runs
findings.hypothesis: floating-point reassociation between different prefill batch shapes (968-token GEMM vs 68-token GEMM over adopted KV), NOT a KV data defect (deterministic, outputs otherwise identical)
resolutionOptions: adjudicate the acceptance bar: semantic equivalence over N generated tokens instead of bit equality
investigate deterministic prefill batching / adoption-path logits in the mlx-swift-lm fork
